Raw cDNA reads are aligned to the reference genome (hg19) using the spliced gap aligner STAR, with count-based quantitation carried out via the Subread package featureCounts at the gene levels. The count data were normalized using “Relative Log Expression” normalization (RLE) implemented in the DESeq2 R package. Poor-quality transcriptome profiles were determined based on inter-sample correlation <0.7 and excluded from the subsequent analyses.

Supplementary_files_format_and_content: .gct file format (tab-delimited text) including normalized gene expression levels normalized within 106 1st biopsy tissues (NAFLD.HUn106.gct) and within the 58 high-risk patients with paired biopsy tissues (NAFLD.HUn164.gct).
